events.title: The death of St. Francis of Assisi
events.shortBlurb: The Poverello died at the Portiuncula near Assisi; his passing is kept by the Franciscans as the Transitus…
body: On the evening of 3 October 1226 St. Francis of Assisi died at the little church of the Portiuncula, having asked to be laid on the bare ground and having added a final stanza to his Canticle of the Creatures welcoming “Sister Death.” His passing is commemorated by the Franciscan family as the Transitus, the eve of his feast.
Two years later he was canonized by Pope Gregory IX.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 4 October
